findings.note: Native MetaBlooms OS source resides in /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS (sandbox). The STAAR repo carries proof artifacts and governance records only. This PR does not claim native OS source was patched here.

g1_policy_design.mounted_path_detection_priority: Recursive scan of ALL string values in tool_input (including arrays and nested dicts) runs BEFORE the explicit domain field is checked. Mounted-path detection cannot be bypassed by setting domain=uploaded_semantic_document_query.
g1_policy_design.tool_canonicalization: file_search.msearch, openai.file_search, FILE_SEARCH, file_search.v2 all canonicalize to 'file_search' before policy lookup.

blocker_fingerprint_design.rationale: identity_fingerprint_fields are hashed to detect structural recurrence. variant_fields are stored and compared separately; changed variant_fields yield LOG_NEW_VARIANT; unchanged yield FORCE_RCA.

g2_implementation.note: All files are new repo-native machinery (policy, scripts, fixtures, tests). No existing non-governance files modified except .gitignore cleanup.

commands_run.note: pytest not available in this environment; stdlib unittest runner used. Fallback recorded per work order requirement.

review_fixes_revision2.fix1_mounted_path_dominates_explicit_dom: classify_domain() now runs _any_string_matches_mounted(tool_input) BEFORE checking tool_input.get('domain'). A call with domain=uploaded_semantic_document_query and any nested /mnt/data path is classified as mounted_mnt_data_os_artifact_truth and BLOCKED.
review_fixes_revision2.fix2_tool_name_canonicalization: canonicalize_tool_name() uses a regex to detect any tool name containing 'file_search' (dot- or underscore-separated) and returns 'file_search'. Covers file_search.msearch, openai.file_search, FILE_SEARCH, file_search.v2.
review_fixes_revision2.fix3_recursive_string_scan: _any_string_matches_mounted() recursively walks dicts, lists, and scalars. Catches /mnt/data in queries[], nested filter dicts, and any other structure in tool_input.
review_fixes_revision2.fix4_schema_corrected: REPEATED_BLOCKER_LEDGER_SCHEMA_v1.json now uses identity_fingerprint_fields (5 structural fields) and variant_fields (input_digest, evidence_digest). Old fingerprint_fields key removed.
review_fixes_revision2.fix5_regression_tests_added: 8 new tests added: test_explicit_domain_bypass_blocked, test_explicit_domain_bypass_via_query_field, test_namespaced_file_search_blocked_fixture_valid, test_namespaced_file_search_blocked, test_various_file_search_aliases_all_blocked, test_non_file_search_alias_not_collapsed, test_nested_mnt_data_in_queries_array_fixture_valid, test_nested_mnt_data_in_queries_array_blocked, test_nested_mnt_data_in_deeply_nested_dict_blocked, test_queries_array_without_mounted_path_not_blocked, test_schema_identity_fingerprint_fields_match_implementation, test_schema_variant_fields_not_in_fingerprint, test_schema_has_identity_and_variant_field_keys.

limitations: Hook integration requires installing Claude Code hooks config (CLAUDE_CODE_HOOKS_TEMPLATE.json); this PR ships the hook scripts but does not modify .claude/settings.json.

canonicalize_tool_name() detects 'file_search' via dot/underscore word-boundary regex. A deliberately obfuscated alias not containing the literal string 'file_search' would not be caught. Remediation: maintain an explicit allowlist of approved tool names.
Recursive string scan walks all values in tool_input at call time. It does not resolve variable references or late-binding tool input fields set by agent runtime after guard invocation.
repeated_blocker_guard.py ledger is a plain JSON file; concurrent writes from parallel hook invocations are not atomic. Acceptable for single-operator governance sessions.
Native MetaBlooms OS source (/mnt/data/Metablooms_OS) is absent from this repo; no OS-level boot or mpp.sh integration is performed here.
pytest not available in this environment; stdlib unittest fallback used. Add pytest to environment for richer output and CI integration.
